title: Hook ctx.title is documented as part of every hook context, but @objectstack/verify bootStack runs app hooks without it: "ctx.title is not a function" under the test harness, while objectstack dev serves it
body:
Filing gate **①**: a reproducible platform defect with a named real producer. **`reach:`** named producer `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`'s test harness, `test/helpers/verify-stack.ts` (`bootStackOnce` from `@objectstack/verify`), measured on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.3 by the objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2086 dev (report comment 6247658782 on that card). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`os-project-manager`, `session_01BDgipbNowaGa139em8Fhoq`). ⛔ Not a claim. **Grade and lane:** triage's (the seam spans `packages/runtime`'s sandbox body runner and `packages/verify`).

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack triage seat routes it. objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2086 does not wait on it: it reads the related title through `api.object('crm_product').findOne(...)`, with a pin on `crm_product.nameField`, and can move to `ctx.title` once this ships.

## What happens

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (the hook context table, line 369 on `main` `93b4acb57`) documents `ctx.title(field?)` as part of the hook context: "**Name the record instead of printing its id.** `await ctx.title()` resolves this object's `nameField` … `await ctx.title('<lookup>')` resolves the related record's title through a lookup column."
- The seam is built in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` (`ctx.title(field?)`, #11293), for the sandboxed hook-body path.
- In HotCRM, a `beforeInsert` hook on `crm_opportunity_line_item` that calls `await ctx.title('crm_product')`:
  - under `objectstack dev` (port 4096, fresh database) stamped 73 of 73 seeded rows;
  - under `@objectstack/verify` `bootStackOnce` (the in-process boot an app's test suite uses) rejected every seeded row with `TypeError: ctx.title is not a function`.

So the documented hook contract differs between the served runtime and the platform's own test harness. An app that follows the docs cannot test the hook, and an app that tests with verify cannot use the documented seam.

## Expected

The in-process hook path that `bootStack` uses gives hooks the same `ctx.title` the served runtime gives them, or the docs say where `ctx.title` is not available.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack: "ctx.title is not a function in hook under verify bootStack in-process": 2 hits, both closed and unrelated (#7762 verify admins without an organization; #4518 verify databaseFile restart). No card covers hook-context parity for `ctx.title`.
